+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+        try:
+            same=float(x)==float(y)
+        except (ValueError,TypeError):
+            same=x==y
+        if not same:
+            bad[key]=[x,y]
+    return bad
+
+

+        assert controller.sha(p)==record['files'][original_path]
+        native[name]=p
+    pgen=ROOT/'solver/athena_ct_diagnostic/x3i_ct_diagnostic.cpp'
+    assert controller.sha(pgen)==record['source_sha256']
+    text=pgen.read_text()
+    assert 'maximum_actual_trace_work_discrepancy=std::max' in text
+    assert 'std::abs(physical_actual)+std::abs(hyd)+1e-99' in text
+    assert 'spd[0] = std::min( wli[IVX]-cfl, wri[IVX]-cfr );' in native['src/hydro/rsolvers/mhd/hlld.cpp'].read_text()
+    low=ROOT/'results/ct96_w30_density_low'
+    ls=json.loads((low/'statistics.json').read_text())
+    lcfg=controller.readcfg(low/'run.cfg')

+            sampling='Maximum over physical inner angular faces and bothSSPRK2 stages. No area/time weight in the local maximum. Integrated work uses0.5dt*facearea and signed sums before taking the final ratio.'),

+            'Reconstruction, an active-side locally subfast wave, native field centering and a boundary/IC transient are candidate explanations. Saved data cannot distinguish them or establish boundary causation.',

+        ],

Bounded running-argmax/exceedance records suffice; avoid logging all16.5million evaluations. Require defaultoff/on state identity before any replay; no derivative/build/replay is performed here.',

+

+    assert bad['indices_within_active_bounds'] and bad['p_code']<0
+    old=controller.readcfg(failed/'run.cfg')
+    baseline=controller.readcfg(base/'run.cfg')
+    assert controller.completion(base,baseline)['scientific_gates_passed']
+    job=controller.prepare('ct96_w30_gamma53_half',pin,SimpleNamespace(output_root=H/'prepared',force=False))
+    assert not job['missing']
+    cfg=job['cfg']

+    duration=bad['mesh_base_day']-float(old['start_day'])
+    gamma=dict(author='Codex-external_model',created_utc=controller.utc(),
